item.title: 5 Under-the-Radar Global Wine Regions to Visit Now | Artful Living Magazine
item.description: From the Swiss Alps to Mexico's Valle de Guadalupe, these lesser-known wine regions deserve to be on every vino connoisseur's travel list.

item.description: Designer Martha Dayton enlists bright color and natural light to breathe new life into the historic Minneapolis Kaufmann House.

item.title: The Guide: Spring Dining Accessories to Elevate Everyday Living | Artful Living Magazine
item.description: From chic glassware to must-have linens, this season's guide welcomes spring with a roster of timeless dining accessories.

item.title: David Coggins’ Sartorial Pairings for the Well-Traveled Oenophile | Artful Living Magazine

item.description: Chatting exclusively with Artful Living, famed New York City culinary figure Keith McNally details his new book, I Regret Almost Everything.

item.title: How Trailblazing Chefs are Redefining American Cuisine Today | Artful Living Magazine
item.description: Acclaimed food writer Jeff Gordinier explores a new generation of chefs and cookbook authors shaping the narrative of American food today.
